name: Stack
description: Vertical flex layout with token-based gap. Children are stacked vertically with consistent spacing.

gap.description: Spacing token name for gap between children (e.g. 'spacing-component-md')

do: Use Stack for vertical layouts with consistent spacing
Use gap prop with spacing tokens for consistent rhythm
doNot: Do not use Stack for horizontal layouts — use Inline instead
Do not pass raw pixel values to gap — use token names

accessibility.notes: Stack is a layout utility with no inherent semantics. Use the 'as' prop for semantic elements like 'nav', 'section', or 'ul'.
